metadata.case_name: NG TAT PING v. CHO SHUI LEUNG T/A FU KEUNG ENGINEER CO.

plaintiff.education_level: studied up to Form 3 in the mainland

injuries.description: 1 cm laceration on left middle finger with 2 tendons cut partially
source: The doctor found a 1 cm laceration on his left middle finger with 2 tendons cut partially.
He had two 'L' shape scars remaining on his proximal phalanges of his middle and ring finger.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple flexor muscles or tendons at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: 1.5 cm laceration on left ring finger with 2 tendons thereat completely severed; repaired tendon ruptured and required further repair
source: On his left ring finger was a 1.5 cm laceration with 2 tendons thereat completely severed.
He was re-admitted into the hospital for another tendon repair operation.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple flexor muscles or tendons at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: loss of active flexion of the ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint
impaired flexion of his ring finger and a mild impairment in the extension of his middle finger
left hand grip was found to be of 66% of the strength of his right hand grip
not able to hold a complete fist
felt stiffness in his 2 injured fingers when he needed to reflex or extend them
would feel pain if he was required to lift heavy object
slight shortening of his left ring finger
two 'L' shape scars remaining on his proximal phalanges of his middle and ring finger
a moderate decrease in power in his right hand grip

losses.description: Loss of mild flexion and extension power of left middle and ring finger; decreased left hand grip; residual scarring and slight shortening of left ring finger affecting hand function

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: The plaintiff used to enjoy playing basketball. After the accident he no longer played the game.

comparable_cases.injury_description: hand injuries of a greater severity (cited as having parity)
